subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the workflow/security owners approve these updated third-party action revisions for credentialed security, publishing, token, and agent workflows after exact-head validation?
rationale: The diff is mechanically narrow, but it changes third-party code running inside several trusted workflows; accepting that supply-chain boundary and validation coverage requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Validate Exact Head
options.body: Rebase onto current main, validate the affected credentialed lanes, and merge if their behavior and permissions remain unchanged.

options.title: Split Sensitive Actions
options.body: Separate ordinary toolchain updates from token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex execution updates for narrower validation and rollback.

options.title: Hold Existing Pins
options.body: Keep the current revisions until the credentialed lanes can be exercised or explicitly accepted without direct proof.

recommendation.title: Validate Exact Head
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, validate the affected credentialed lanes, and merge if their behavior and permissions remain unchanged.
